# SOTA of EDA — LLM-readable project index

## What this site is
A machine-readable, hierarchical registry of EDA (Electronic Design Automation) research baselines.
Helps check whether a paper's compared methods match the paper's claim, benchmark scope, and caveats.
Not a leaderboard — it is a reference index where each baseline is backed by evidence.

## How an agent should query this site

### Quick lookup (fetch once)
- Full registry as JSON: `GET https://sota-of-eda.github.io/registry.json`
  Returns an array of topics. Each topic has:
  - `topic_id`, `parent_id` (hierarchy), `short_name`, `display_name`, `description`
  - `baselines[]`: each with `baseline_id`, `short_name`, `display_name`, `role`, `publication` (venue/year/doi/bibtex), `links` (paper/pdf/arxiv/repo/project URLs), `compare_when[]`, `benchmark_scope[]`, `metrics[]`, `reproducibility`, `caveats[]`

### Fuzzy search (in-browser)
The search box on the page filters topics (by short_name, display_name, description) and baselines (by short_name, display_name) with substring matching. An agent using a headless browser can type into `input.search-input` and read `.search-dropdown`.

### Stay updated
- Atom feed: `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/atom.xml` (entries generated from git commit history on each push)
- Sitemap: `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/sitemap.xml`

## Agents well-known endpoint
- `https://sota-of-eda.github.io/.well-known/agent.json` — machine-readable API descriptor

## Schema
- JSON Schema for topics and baselines: `https://github.com/sota-of-eda/sota-of-eda.github.io/blob/main/data/schema/topic.schema.json`
- Baseline roles: `canonical_baseline`, `candidate_recent_baseline`, `artifact_baseline`, `historical_reference`
- Reproducibility: `reproduced`, `artifact_available`, `paper_only`, `unknown`

## Contributing
- Use the sota-baseline-collector Claude Code skill (see `.agents/skills/` in the repo).
- Or edit `data/topics/*.yaml` manually and open a PR.
- Most entries are AI-generated and may contain errors — review before citing.
